text:
mara_cs: starting Harbinger dedicated pool bring-up today. main targets: quota check, autoscale stress, KV warmup, and a brief chaos failover. sharing run cadence here.

jason_runtime: uploaded traffic profile + quota sheet: https://drive.redwood/harbinger/quota-gamma

linda_sre: ask: target SLOs? tail latency, error ceiling, budget guard?

mara_cs: SLOs: 99p < 350ms, error <0.5%, soft budget $3k/hr. expected steady 100 qps, sustained peak 400 qps, bursts up to 900 qps. KV warmup required.

jason_runtime: we'll serve prod(fp16) and fallback(int8-lite). runtime will prefer prod until node health triggers fallback.

omar_oncall: canary plan: 5% x3m -> 20% x12m -> 50% x30m -> full if green. insert health snapshots each step.

linda_sre: propose autoscale rules: scale up if GPU util >60% for 45s, +2 nodes, max 12. scale down if <35% for 5m. circuit open on 5% errors >30s.

mara_cs: customer checklist for enablement call:
- quota visible in console
- warmup script executed 30m prior
- failover route tested to hosted smallmodel
- alerts set for latency, error, and cost

jason_runtime: warmup command: `./prefix_warmup.sh --url http://dedicated.harbinger.internal --tokens 100000 --concurrency 8` start 30m before canary.

deploy-bot: deploy-started: dedicated/harbinger v1.5 -> desired_nodes:4

omar_oncall: mid-ramp chaos: simulate single-node OOM at +40m; expect fallback within 30s.

linda_sre: add pre-burst rebalance: if tail latency rises >150ms for 60s, trigger rebalance job.

jason_runtime: adding telemetry to tag fallback-served requests for billing.

mara_cs: set abort triggers: spend >3200 USD/hr OR 95p latency >600ms => autopause and notify #billing + #eng-oncall.

deploy-bot: deploy-complete: dedicated/harbinger v1.5 -> active_nodes:6

omar_oncall: canary green at 3m. ramping to 20%. will post status updates.

jason_runtime: KV hit rate after warmup = 86%. 99p at 50% = 335ms. traces: /traces/harbinger/2475003000

linda_sre: saw brief tail spike during first burst; hot shard on node-4. auto-rebalance recovered latency. no user errors.

omar_oncall: injected chaos at +40m. fallback engaged 20s. no dropped requests. resuming ramp.

mara_cs: quick retro notes: warmup timing OK, autoscale sensible with small tuning, fallback fast, need scheduled pre-burst rebalance (action: jason).

jason_runtime: will add scheduled rebalance 90s pre-burst and shard-aware placement.

mara_cs: thanks team. post-run retro at 15:00 PT. i'll compile customer feedback form and results. closing thread when report posted. :thumbsup:
